##### Project general facts

Al Ameera Village 5 emerges as a thoughtfully designed residential community that masterfully blends modern architecture with everyday comfort, creating a relaxed living environment perfectly suited for today's evolving lifestyle. This exceptional development, situated within the welcoming Al Yasmeen Community, offers a curated selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences that have been meticulously crafted to maximise space and natural light. Each home reflects an unwavering commitment to quality and contemporary elegance, providing residents with a sanctuary where comfort meets sophisticated living in perfect harmony.

The residences at Al Ameera Village 5 are complemented by an impressive array of on-site amenities that elevate daily life to new heights of convenience and wellbeing. Residents are invited to enjoy a fully-equipped gym, a spacious swimming pool, dedicated kids' play areas, and luxurious sauna and steam rooms, all within the security of round-the-clock surveillance and multi-storey parking. The development also features relaxation zones, a health club, and convenient retail and restaurant options, ensuring that every need is anticipated and every desire is fulfilled without ever leaving the community.

Beyond the exceptional on-site facilities, Al Ameera Village 5 benefits from its prime location within the Al Yasmeen Community, where residents have effortless access to schools, mosques, shopping destinations, and essential services. The thoughtful integration of modern design with practical amenities creates a living environment that is both serene and dynamic, offering the perfect foundation for families and professionals alike. This is a place where every detail has been considered to foster a sense of belonging and enhance the quality of life for all who call it home.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Yasmeen offers the perfect blend of modern living and exceptional accessibility, placing residents within effortless reach of Ajman's most cherished destinations and beyond. This vibrant community is ideally situated just minutes from Ajman City Centre, Ajman Beach, and essential healthcare facilities, while tranquil Al Hamediya Park lies practically at the doorstep. The neighbourhood's strategic position ensures that every convenience, from shopping at Safeer Mall to enjoying the coastal beauty of Al Hamriyah Beach, is always wonderfully close at hand.

Life within Al Yasmeen is defined by its remarkable connectivity to the wider region, with Sharjah International Airport just a short journey away and Dubai International Airport reachable within a comfortable drive. The community's exceptional location provides seamless access to Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, making it an ideal choice for those who value both serene suburban living and urban excitement. Residents enjoy the best of both worlds, with the tranquillity of Ajman complemented by the dynamic allure of Dubai's most prestigious destinations.

The surroundings of Al Yasmeen offer a wealth of lifestyle amenities, from markets and shopping centres to schools, universities, parks, and recreation centres, all designed to enrich daily life. The neighbourhood's walking areas, sitting areas, and diverse dining options create a warm and welcoming atmosphere that fosters a true sense of community. This distinguished address truly offers an unparalleled living experience, combining the comfort of a family-friendly community with the convenience of exceptional connectivity to the Northern Emirates and beyond.
